subject: Amplify reserved GPU plan — capacity uplift request and go‑live runbook
messages:
From: Camille DuPont <camille@querna.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@querna.com; ops@querna.com
Date: 2026-07-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: increase reserved pool for Q4 feature ramp

Hi Kimberly —

We ran the numbers after the last load test and we need to move from our current 8‑GPU reserved pool to 16 GPUs to hit the latency objectives for the new streaming feature. Procurement looped me in for the contract/commit side; ops wants an activation runbook so they can stage nodes without disrupting current traffic.

Can Redwood provide:
- A proposed monthly commit that maps to 16 GPUs (we need predictable billing starting Oct 1)
- A throughput SLO we can include in the SOW (tokens/sec baseline for the 16 GPU pool)
- An activation plan (canary & cutover) — ops wants the checklist/documentation

We'd like to keep the current pricing baseline if possible and add the additional GPUs under the renewal. Target decision by next Tuesday (7/27).

Thanks,
Camille
Product Ops, Querna

Attachments: sample load trace (referenced)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Camille DuPont <camille@querna.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com; grace_oconnor@redwood.com; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-22T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: increase reserved pool for Q4 feature ramp

Hi Camille —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can provision an additional 8 GPUs to reach 16 and we can fold the change into your renewal so billing begins Oct 1. Below is a high‑level proposal — I'll attach a draft SOW and an activation runbook for ops to review.

Proposal summary:
- Monthly commit (16 GPU reserved pool): USD 44,500/month (this reflects a blended rate; includes a 12% uplift over your current 8‑GPU baseline to account for reserved capacity pricing and guaranteed throughput).
- Throughput SLO (per pool): 60k tokens/sec sustained across the pool (burst to 75k tokens/sec for up to 30s). We’ll include a per‑month availability SLA of 99.5% for serving nodes; credits and fallback plan noted in the SOW.
- Activation window: 2‑stage activation (canary: 2 GPUs -> mid‑week smoke tests; bulk activation: remaining 6 GPUs with staged traffic shift over 48 hours).

What I need from you by EOD Monday: final PO contact for procurement and a go/no‑go on the proposed SLA figures. If procurement prefers a different billing cadence (quarterly vs monthly), we can draft an amendment.

Attached: SOW_Amplify-Uplift_v3.pdf (draft), Querna_Activation_Runbook_v1.docx, throughput_projection_q3.xlsx

Best,
Kimberly
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

--
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0173

From: Camille DuPont <camille@querna.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@querna.com; ops@querna.com
Date: 2026-07-23T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: increase reserved pool for Q4 feature ramp

Kimberly —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifying points from procurement and ops:
- Procurement asks whether the 44,500/month is tax exclusive and whether there is a one‑time activation fee.
- Ops asked whether the 60k tokens/sec SLO assumes our standard batching profile (avg seq len 220) — they sent sample traces (see attached).
- For go‑live timing, we prefer a mid‑September activation so we can align with our release window (still fine with Oct 1 billing).

Procurement contact: Priya Menon <procurement@querna.com> (please send the PO template and updated SOW).

Camille

Looping EngOps and Finance notes for the runbook and billing questions. Key points from EngOps:
- The 60k tokens/sec SLO is reasonable under the stated batching assumptions (avg seq 220) but we want a short calibration window post‑activation (48‑72 hours) to validate token error budgets and model quantization profile.
- No mandatory activation fee from infra — we bill only the reserved commit. We will provide an ops checklist and a post‑activation test harness.

Grace: I attached a trimmed runbook (Querna_Activation_Runbook_v1.docx) — please review the canary steps and the rollback plan.

Finance input (Stephanie): confirm whether the 44,500 number includes the standard enterprise support addon or if that remains separate. Stephanie?

Thanks,
Aditya — Technical Sales Engineer

--
Aditya Rao | aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Camille DuPont <camille@querna.com>; kimberly_park@redwood.com; aditya_rao@redwood.com; grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-27T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: increase reserved pool for Q4 feature ramp — SOW and PO next steps

Hi all —

Finance here. Quick confirmations:
- USD 44,500/month is tax exclusive. We will issue an invoice on the first billing cycle (Oct 1) unless you prefer pro‑rata for the partial activation window in September. Let me know if Querna requires pro‑rata and we'll include it in the SOW.
- No activation fee. The price assumes standard Enterprise Support is included (Platinum) — if you want 24x7 SLAs with a named TAM, there is a separate addendum.

Next steps for procurement:
1) Camille / Priya to confirm go‑live week (preferred: week of Sep 13) or request pro‑rata.
2) I will send a PO template and the SOW (final PDF) via DocuSign after confirmation.
3) EngOps and Querna ops to sign off on the activation runbook; we'll schedule a dry run two weeks prior to canary.

Camille, if you confirm the Sep 13 window by EOD Monday we will prepare the DocuSign and targeted activation calendar.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Amplify-Uplift_v3.pdf (for signature)

Camille
